name: Cutting Tool Harvest Caption
description: A villager harvesting blackberries with a cutting tool (dropped where the tribe's cutting tools are used on the blackberries) now says "Harvesting berries with a cutting tool" instead of "Harvesting blackberries", so it can be told apart from picking. Picking blackberries and every other caption are unchanged. The words are shortened from "Harvesting blackberries with a cutting tool" because the game's caption holds at most 39 letters. **Needs no other patch.** **Off by default; Owner's Defaults ticks it.** **Unverified in play: the effect has not been tested live.** The companion is "VVFP VV4 Harvest Caption.dll", started by VVFP Startup.dll; if the DLL cannot be loaded, the stock caption shows.
behavior_changes: Picking (action 99, 0x451C30) and the cutting-tool harvest (action 0xBE, 0x451CE0) both copy text 0x280 "Harvesting blackberries" into the villager's caption (+0x1CE4, 0x27 letters, 0x4724E0); the harvest's copy (0x451CF6) now copies "Harvesting berries with a cutting tool" (38 letters), translated through VVFP Translations.dll (row vvfp.harvest_caption/vvfp_vv4_harvest_caption.caption.s0).
explicit_non_changes: Picking, the harvest itself (the tool used, the berries, the food) and every other caption are the game's own; the game's text table is not changed.
No executable byte is patched: the companion writes one jump at run time after verifying the site and the code around it; a different build installs nothing. Nothing is written anywhere.
evidence_status: implemented from exact-build disassembly; the harvest's and the pick's captions emulated in tests/test_vv4_cloth_sacks.py; runtime/player confirmation pending

runtime_detours.routine: the cutting-tool harvest 0x451CE0 (action 0xBE), copying its caption (push 0x27 / push eax, the looked-up text 0x280 / lea eax, [esi+0x1CE4]; then push eax / call 0x4724E0 at 0x451CFF): the companion's caption is pushed instead
runtime_detours.installed_by: VVFP VV4 Harvest Caption.dll, VvfpStartup (started by VVFP Startup.dll, second word)
